title: Evaluation of VX-581 in Healthy Participants and in Participants With Cystic Fibrosis
official: A Phase 1 Study of VX-581 in Healthy Subjects and in Subjects With Cystic Fibrosis
summary: The purpose of this study is to evaluate the safety, tolerability, and pharmacokinetics of single dose of VX-581 and multiple ascending doses of VX-581 alone and in combination with tezacaftor (TEZ)/deutivacaftor (D-IVA) or D-IVA in healthy participants. The study will also evaluate the safety, tolerability, and pharmacokinetics of VX-581 administered in combination with D-IVA with or without TEZ in participants with cystic fibrosis (CF).
criteria:
Key Inclusion Criteria:

* Parts A, B, C:

  * Body mass index (BMI) of 18.0 to 32.0 kilogram per meter square (kg/m\^2)
  * A total body weight of more than (\>) 50 kg
* Part D:

  * Confirmed diagnosis of CF

Key Exclusion Criteria:

* Parts A, B, C:

  * History of febrile illness or other acute illness that has not fully resolved within 14 days before the first dose of study drug
  * Any condition possibly affecting drug absorption
* Part D:

  * History of clinically significant cirrhosis with or without portal hypertension.

Other protocol defined Inclusion/Exclusion criteria may apply.
